name: AeroVironment (AVAV)
teaser: Hold, watchlist for new money. At $85.80 the shares trade 12.1% above my Base value of $76.56. The September buy price of $86.10 has been reached, but it rested on a Base value that was too generous. The rebuilt model asks for a 42.5% margin of safety, which puts the maximum buy price at $44.02, 48.7% below today's price. Free cash flow is still negative and the Bear value is $32.65.
llms: Drone, loitering munition and defense technology company transformed by the BlueHalo acquisition, valued on a discounted exit value of fiscal 2028 EBITDA after stock compensation with a ten-year cash flow cross-check; record backlog but negative free cash flow. Bear $32.65, Base $76.56, Bull $140.76. Verdict HOLD at $85.80 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $44.02.
